sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里，人们发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被抽干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她只被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Late in the afternoon on Monday, September 30, 2019, a call came through to police in the city of Anchorage, Alaska,
sentences.zh: 2019年9月30日星期一的下午晚些时候，阿拉斯加州安克雷奇市警方接到了一通电话，

sentences.en: regarding a disturbing discovery in the Fairview neighbourhood, just east of downtown.
sentences.zh: 内容是关于市中心正东面费尔维尤街区发现的一起令人不安的事情。

sentences.en: A passerby who'd been near a grocery store at the corner of Gamble Street and 13th Avenue had noticed something lying on the ground.
sentences.zh: 一名路人当时在甘布尔街和第十三大道交汇处的一家杂货店附近，注意到地上有什么东西躺着。

sentences.en: It was a micro-SD card, a small flash memory device commonly used in portable electronics such as digital cameras and mobile phones.
sentences.zh: 那是一张微型SD卡，这是一种小型闪存设备，常见于数码相机和手机等便携式电子设备中。

sentences.en: The card was labelled, Homicide at Midtown Marriott.
sentences.zh: 卡上贴着标签，写着“中城万豪酒店谋杀案”。

sentences.en: Driven by curiosity, the person who found the card inserted it into a device to examine its contents.
sentences.zh: 出于好奇，发现这张卡的人把它插入设备中查看里面的内容。

sentences.en: It held a series of photographs and videos, all dated earlier that month.
sentences.zh: 里面有一系列照片和视频，日期都是当年那个月早些时候。

sentences.en: The content was of amateur quality and appeared to have been recorded on a smartphone.
sentences.zh: 内容是业余水平，似乎是用智能手机录制的。

sentences.en: Upon pressing play on one of the videos,
sentences.zh: 当按下其中一个视频的播放键时，

sentences.en: the viewer was immediately confronted by the image of a naked woman with long dark hair sprawled on her back across a distinctive patterned carpet.
sentences.zh: 观看者立刻看到了一名赤裸的女子，她有着一头长长的黑发，仰面大字型躺在地上一块独特的图案地毯上。

sentences.en: Her face was severely bruised, swollen and bloodied.
sentences.zh: 她的面部严重瘀伤、红肿且带血。

sentences.en: From behind the camera, a man spoke with a distinct accent.
sentences.zh: 镜头背后，一个男子操着浓重的口音说话。

sentences.en: Though his face and body never appeared on screen, his hands were visible as he struck and strangled the battered woman, who reacted weakly as though she was barely conscious.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的脸和身体从未出现在镜头前，但当他殴打并勒住那个遭受虐待、反应虚弱得似乎快要失去意识的女子时，他的双手清晰可见。

sentences.en: Almost two weeks earlier, on the night of Thursday, September 19, 2019,
sentences.zh: 将近两周前，即2019年9月19日星期四的晚上，

sentences.en: 52-year-old Valerie Kassler had been standing near the grocery store at the corner of Gamble Street and 13th Avenue in Anchorage.
sentences.zh: 52岁的瓦莱莉·卡斯勒当时正站在安克雷奇甘布尔街和第十三大道交汇处的杂货店附近。

sentences.en: Just before 2am, a lone man emerged from the cold darkness.
sentences.zh: 就在凌晨2点之前，一个孤身男子从寒冷的黑暗中出现。

sentences.en: He was white with a short, solidly built frame, grey hair and sharp facial features.
sentences.zh: 他是白人，身材矮壮，留着灰发，面部轮廓分明。

sentences.en: As he spoke, Valerie noticed his voice was marked by a foreign accent that sounded European to her.
sentences.zh: 当他说话时，瓦莱莉注意到他的声音带有外国口音，在她听来像是欧洲口音。

sentences.en: Valerie, who performed sex work, agreed to go with the man.
sentences.zh: 从事性交易的瓦莱莉同意跟这个男人走。

sentences.en: She got into the passenger seat of his black Ford Ranger pickup truck and he drove her a few blocks south to Mulcahy Baseball Stadium, then onto the neighbouring Sullivan Arena.
sentences.zh: 她坐进他那辆黑色福特Ranger皮卡车的副驾驶座，他开车把她载到南边几个街区外的马尔卡希棒球场，然后又开到附近的沙利文竞技场。

sentences.en: They stayed in his truck until 4am when the man said that he needed to withdraw cash to pay her.
sentences.zh: 他们一直待在他的卡车里，直到凌晨4点，那名男子说他需要去取现金来付钱给她。

sentences.en: He drove to a Shell gas station and pulled in.
sentences.zh: 他开车来到一家壳牌加油站并驶了进去。

sentences.en: The man began searching his truck for a misplaced cell phone.
sentences.zh: 这名男子开始在卡车里搜寻一部不知放哪儿了的手机。

sentences.en: It wasn't his regular phone, but an older, additional model he happened to have in the vehicle for some reason.
sentences.zh: 那不是他的常用手机，而是一部较旧的备用型号，不知为何他恰好放在车里。

sentences.en: After a brief, unsuccessful search, he gave up and went into the gas station to use the ATM.
sentences.zh: 经过一番短暂而徒劳的搜寻后，他放弃了，走进加油站去使用自动取款机。

sentences.en: He returned a few minutes later and continued driving Valerie around until 7am before dropping her off at a tent in a wooded area near a church where she was staying at the time.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后他回来了，继续开车带着瓦莱莉到处转，直到早上7点，才把她放在教堂附近树林里的一顶帐篷旁，她当时就住在那里。

sentences.en: Once alone in her tent, Valerie pulled out the man's phone.
sentences.zh: 独自呆在帐篷里后，瓦莱莉掏出了那个男人的手机。

sentences.en: She had found it under her car seat while he was inside the gas station and had pocketed it without a word.
sentences.zh: 她是在他进加油站时在他的车座底下发现的，并二话不说把它揣进了口袋。

sentences.en: Its battery was dead, so she went elsewhere to charge the device.
sentences.zh: 它的电池没电了，于是她去了别的地方给设备充电。

sentences.en: Once it powered up, she returned to her tent and turned it on.
sentences.zh: 一旦充上电，她就回到了帐篷并把它打开。

sentences.en: Scrolling through the phone's apps, she stumbled upon a series of images and videos taken earlier that month.
sentences.zh: 在手机的应用里滑动时，她偶然发现了一系列拍摄于当月早些时候的照片和视频。

sentences.en: Valerie, who struggled with alcohol and drug use disorder, had spent the past two weeks on a prolonged bender.
sentences.zh: 与酒精和药物滥用障碍作斗争的瓦莱莉，在过去两周里一直处于长时间的纵酒狂欢中。

sentences.en: When she viewed the phone's contents, she immediately sobered up.
sentences.zh: 当她查看手机内容时，她酒意全无，瞬间清醒了。

sentences.en: A man had filmed himself violently attacking and cruelly mocking a badly beaten woman inside a room.
sentences.zh: 一个男人拍摄了自己在一个房间里暴力袭击并残酷嘲弄一个饱受虐待的女子的过程。

sentences.en: The patterned carpet beneath the woman was instantly familiar to Valerie.
sentences.zh: 女子身下的图案地毯瓦莱莉一眼就认出来了。

sentences.en: It was the same one found in the guest rooms at the Marriott Town Place Suites in downtown Anchorage, about two miles south of Fairview.
sentences.zh: 它与安克雷奇市中心万豪唐帕斯套房酒店客房里的地毯一模一样，该酒店位于费尔维尤以南大约两英里处。

sentences.en: While the attacker's face never appeared on the video, his voice did.
sentences.zh: 虽然袭击者的脸从未出现在视频中，但他的声音出现了。

sentences.en: Valerie immediately recognised his distinct accent.
sentences.zh: 瓦莱莉立刻听出了他那独特的口音。

sentences.en: It belonged to the man she had spent the previous night with.
sentences.zh: 那是她前一天晚上与之共度时光的那个男人的声音。

sentences.en: The owner of the phone.
sentences.zh: 手机的主人。

sentences.en: Valerie didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 瓦莱莉不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Reporting the troubling discovery might lead to her own arrest, either for stealing the phone, or worse, for prostitution if she admitted why they were together in the first place.
sentences.zh: 报告这个令人不安的发现可能会导致她自己被捕，无论是因为偷了手机，还是更糟糕的，如果她承认他们最初为什么在一起的话，会因为卖淫被捕。

sentences.en: Finally, driven by the fear that the man might harm another woman, Valerie came up with a plan.
sentences.zh: 最后，出于担心这个男人可能会伤害另一个女性的恐惧，瓦莱莉想出了一个计划。

sentences.en: Days after taking the phone, she transferred its incriminating images and videos to a micro SD card.
sentences.zh: 拿走手机几天后，她将其中的罪证照片和视频传输到了一张微型SD卡上。

sentences.en: She then labelled the card Homicide at Midtown Marriott, wanting authorities to have as much information as possible about the crime once they got their hands on it.
sentences.zh: 然后，她在卡片上贴上了“中城万豪酒店谋杀案”的标签，希望当局在拿到卡片后能掌握尽可能多的关于这起犯罪的信息。

sentences.en: On Monday September 30, Valerie went to her doctor's office with the SD card.
sentences.zh: 9月30日星期一，瓦莱莉带着这张SD卡去了她医生的诊所。

sentences.en: She made up a story about finding the card on the ground near the grocery store where she had first encountered the man.
sentences.zh: 她编造了一个故事，说是在她最初遇到那个男人的杂货店附近的地上捡到了这张卡。

sentences.en: The doctor called the police on Valerie's behalf and she handed the card over to investigators.
sentences.zh: 医生代表瓦莱莉报了警，她将卡片交给了调查人员。

sentences.en: Although Valerie initially lied about how she came into possession of the SD card fearing legal repercussions,
sentences.zh: 尽管瓦莱莉出于对法律后果的恐惧，最初对她是如何得到这张SD卡的撒了谎，

sentences.en: she eventually came clean and admitted to having stolen the offender's cell phone.
sentences.zh: 但她最终还是坦白了，承认自己偷了加害者的手机。

sentences.en: By the time she spoke with police, however, she no longer had the device, explaining that she had since lost it somewhere in the woods.
sentences.zh: 然而，当她与警方交谈时，她已经没有那个设备了，解释说她后来把它弄丢在树林里的某个地方了。

sentences.en: Investigators corroborated her account by reviewing CCTV footage from the Shell gas station where she said the man had stopped to withdraw cash.
sentences.zh: 调查人员调取了她所说的那家男子停下来取现金的壳牌加油站的闭路电视监控录像，从而证实了她的说法。

sentences.en: The footage showed the man entering the store, browsing snacks and drinks, then spending several minutes at the ATM before returning to his truck, where Valerie was waiting.
sentences.zh: 录像显示该男子进入商店，浏览零食和饮料，然后在自动取款机前呆了几分钟，接着返回他的卡车，瓦莱莉正坐在那里等候。

sentences.en: The SD card contained 12 videos and 39 photos in total, all created over a three-day period between September 3 and 6, 2019.
sentences.zh: 该SD卡总共包含12个视频和39张照片，全部拍摄于2019年9月3日至6日之间的三天时间内。

sentences.en: The victim appeared to be an Alaska native woman, though the injuries to her face were so severe that she was unrecognisable.
sentences.zh: 受害者似乎是一位阿拉斯加原住民女性，不过她面部的伤势如此严重，以至于让人认不出本来面目。

sentences.en: Neither the offender's face nor body were visible in any of the content, but his right hand could be seen repeatedly slapping and strangling the woman.
sentences.zh: 在所有内容中都看不到加害者的脸或身体，但可以看到他的右手多次扇耳光并勒住这个女人。

sentences.en: She struggled to breathe, clawing at his wrist in a desperate attempt to make him stop.
sentences.zh: 她呼吸困难，绝望地抓挠着他的手腕，试图让他停下来。

sentences.en: At intervals, he loosened his grip, leaving her gasping for air before the assault resumed.
sentences.zh: 断断续续地，他放松了手劲，让她喘口气，随后又恢复了袭击。

sentences.en: Throughout the videos, the man's voice could be heard.
sentences.zh: 在整个视频中，都可以听到这个男人的声音。

sentences.en: Speaking with a distinctive foreign accent, he complained that his hand was getting tired, before inflicting further harm on the woman with his foot.
sentences.zh: 他带着独特的外国口音，抱怨着自己的手快酸了，随后用脚对这个女人施加了进一步的伤害。

sentences.en: He verbally abused her, stating,
sentences.zh: 他用言语辱骂她，说道：

sentences.en: You need to fucking die, bitch.
sentences.zh: 你他妈得去死，贱货。

sentences.en: Just fucking die.
sentences.zh: 给老子去死。

sentences.en: At one point, he pulled out a piece of string and wrapped it around the woman's neck, tightening it and then releasing it.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，他掏出一根绳子，缠在女人的脖子上，勒紧然后又松开。

sentences.en: Each time he let go, he said the words, you live, followed by the words, you die, as he pulled the string taut again.
sentences.zh: 每次他松手时，他就说“你活着”这句话，接着又把绳子拉紧并说“你死了”这句话。

sentences.en: Then he added,
sentences.zh: 然后他又补充道：

sentences.en: Sadly, in my movies, everyone dies.
sentences.zh: 可悲的是，在我的电影里，每个人都得死。

sentences.en: The man hummed the suspenseful instrumental theme from the movie Jaws, made bizarre sound effects with his mouth and tongue,
sentences.zh: 这个男人哼唱着电影《大白鲨》中充满悬念的器乐主题曲，用嘴和舌头发出奇异的音效，

sentences.en: and sang the song Thunderstruck by Australian rock band ACDC.
sentences.zh: 并演唱了澳大利亚摇滚乐队ACDC的歌曲《Thunderstruck》。

sentences.en: As the woman struggled to breathe, the man laughed and mocked her as he continued to torture her.
sentences.zh: 当女人挣扎着呼吸时，这个男人一边继续折磨她，一边大笑并嘲笑她。

sentences.en: He complained about how long she was taking to die, berating her that it was cutting into his drinking time.
sentences.zh: 他抱怨她死去花了这么长时间，责骂这耽误了他喝酒的时间。

sentences.en: When some of her blood got onto his hand, he became upset and accused her of giving him hepatitis.
sentences.zh: 当她的一些血溅到他手上时，他变得很不高兴，指责她把乙肝传染给了他。

sentences.en: At times, he spoke as though acknowledging an audience that might be watching the videos.
sentences.zh: 有时，他说话的语气好像是在向可能正在观看视频的观众致意。

sentences.en: He made remarks about trying to get the right action shot and winning an Oscar.
sentences.zh: 他发表评论说要拍到正确的动作镜头并赢得奥斯卡奖。

sentences.en: At one point, he said to the victim,
sentences.zh: 有一次，他对受害者说：

sentences.en: Listen, you need to finish this movie, because I just can't fucking go on anymore.
sentences.zh: 听着，你得把这部电影拍完，因为我他妈真的再也坚持不下去了。

sentences.en: What are my followers going to think of me?
sentences.zh: 我的粉丝们会怎么看我？

sentences.en: People need to know when they are being serial killed.
sentences.zh: 人们需要知道他们什么时候被连环谋杀。

sentences.en: The woman appeared to be unconscious throughout, with her occasional defensive reactions and attempts to breathe seeming more like reflexes than conscious actions.
sentences.zh: 这个女人全程似乎都处于无意识状态，她偶尔的防御反应和呼吸尝试看起来更像是本能反射而不是有意识的动作。

sentences.en: In total, the videos amounted to more than 35 minutes of harrowing footage.
sentences.zh: 总计下来，这些视频有超过35分钟令人揪心的画面。

sentences.en: A distinct blue and black bag was occasionally visible in the frame.
sentences.zh: 画面中偶尔能看到一个独特的蓝黑相间的包。

sentences.en: The first still image had been taken at 12.59am on Wednesday September 4.
sentences.zh: 第一张静态照片拍摄于9月4日星期三凌晨12点59分。

sentences.en: In this picture, the woman was still lying on the hotel room floor next to a bed, her right eye partially open, and her left eye bruised and swollen shut,
sentences.zh: 在这张照片中，这名女子仍然躺在床边一侧的酒店房间地板上，她的右眼半睁着，左眼瘀青红肿紧闭，

sentences.en: with blood along its opening.
sentences.zh: 眼缝处带着血迹。

sentences.en: Her lips were blue and bloodied.
sentences.zh: 她的嘴唇发青且带血。

sentences.en: Later images showed the woman wrapped in a bed sheet, posed halfway on the foot of the bed with red ligature marks visible on her neck.
sentences.zh: 随后的照片显示，这名女子被床单包裹着，半躺在床尾，脖子上可见红色的勒痕。

sentences.en: Two hours later, at 2.51 and 2.52am, photos taken in a parking lot showed a rolling hotel luggage cart parked next to a black,
sentences.zh: 两个小时后，即凌晨2点51分和2点52分，在停车场拍摄的照片显示，一辆滚轮酒店行李车停在一辆黑色的、

sentences.en: older model Ford Ranger pickup truck with a white topper on it.
sentences.zh: 较老款带有白色车顶盖的福特Ranger皮卡车旁边。

sentences.en: The woman's body lay on the luggage cart, covered by a white blanket with her head partially exposed.
sentences.zh: 女子的尸体躺在行李车上，盖着一条白色的毯子，头部部分露在外面。

sentences.en: Following this were seven photos of the woman lying face down in the back of the truck.
sentences.zh: 紧随其后的是七张女子脸朝下躺在卡车后部的照片。

sentences.en: She was covered by the white blanket as well as a blue tarp and concealed from view by the white top fitted to the truck bed.
sentences.zh: 她被白毯子以及一块蓝色防水布盖着，并被安装在卡车货厢上的白色车顶盖遮挡住，不被人看见。

sentences.en: The last of these photographs was dated Friday September 6 at 1.12am, more than 48 hours after the first video was taken.
sentences.zh: 这些照片中的最后一张拍摄于9月6日星期五凌晨1点12分，距离拍摄第一段视频已经过去了48个多小时。

sentences.en: Nothing in the photos or video footage immediately revealed the identities of either the victim or the offender.
sentences.zh: 照片或视频画面中的任何内容都无法直接透露受害者或加害者的身份。

sentences.en: Valerie Casler provided a physical description of the man whose phone she had stolen, but the most compelling lead was his distinctive accent.
sentences.zh: 瓦莱莉·卡斯勒提供了她偷了手机的那个男人的体貌特征，但最具决定性的线索是他那独特的口音。

sentences.en: Valerie thought the man sounded European, but some of the police officers speculated that he might be English.
sentences.zh: 瓦莱莉认为这个男人的口音听起来像欧洲人，但一些警官推测他可能是英国人。

sentences.en: However, one detective reviewing the videos knew that it was neither of those.
sentences.zh: 然而，一名审查视频的侦探知道那两者都不是。

sentences.en: He knew because he recognised the voice as soon as he heard it.
sentences.zh: 他之所以知道，是因为他一听到这个声音就认出来了。

sentences.en: 2016 had been a difficult year for 39-year-old Alicia Youngblood.
sentences.zh: 2016年对于39岁的阿莉西亚·杨布拉德来说是艰难的一年。

sentences.en: Over the course of two weeks, she had been laid off at work, lost her home after her landlady needed to sell the property, and her truck broke down.
sentences.zh: 在两周的时间里，她先是工作被裁，接着因为女房东需要卖掉房产而失去了住所，最后她的卡车也抛锚了。

sentences.en: Family and friends supported Alicia and her six children until she could get back on her feet, but by the summer of 2017, she was ready for a fresh start.
sentences.zh: 家人和朋友支持着阿莉西亚和她的六个孩子，直到她重新振作起来，但到了2017年夏天，她已经准备好迎接全新的开始。

sentences.en: She decided to move north from her home in Texas to the state of Alaska.
sentences.zh: 她决定从德克萨斯州的家向北搬到阿拉斯加州。

sentences.en: Alicia's warm, outgoing personality, coupled with her adventurous spirit, ensured that the change wouldn't be too difficult.
sentences.zh: 阿莉西亚热情开朗的性格，加上她冒险的精神，确保了这次搬迁不会太困难。

sentences.en: She found a job at an engineering firm called Dow Engineering and began making friends in her new city, Anchorage.
sentences.zh: 她在一家名为道氏工程的工程公司找到了一份工作，并开始在她的新城市安克雷奇结交朋友。

sentences.en: One of these friends was a 46-year-old colleague named Brian Smith.
sentences.zh: 其中一位朋友是一位46岁的同事，名叫布赖恩·史密斯。

sentences.en: The two got to know each other after Smith started training Alicia to perform site inspections.
sentences.zh: 在史密斯开始培训阿莉西亚进行现场检查后，两人开始互相了解。

sentences.en: Smith was relatively new to Anchorage as well, having moved there from South Africa in 2014.
sentences.zh: 史密斯对安克雷奇来说也相对陌生，他于2014年从南非搬到那里。

sentences.en: Years earlier, he had served in the South African Army before working at a software company and later managing guest houses.
sentences.zh: 多年前，他曾在南非军队服役，之后在一家软件公司工作，后来管理过宾馆。

sentences.en: At one point, he tried to launch his own online dating site, but it didn't take off.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他试图推出自己的在线约会网站，但没有成功。

sentences.en: However, he did have personal success in meeting someone online.
sentences.zh: 不过，他在网上结识某人方面确实取得了个人成功。

sentences.en: In 2013, Brian Smith began an internet relationship with an American woman named Stephanie, whom he met through online gaming.
sentences.zh: 2013年，布赖恩·史密斯通过网络游戏结识了一名叫斯蒂芬妮的美国女子，并与之开展了一段网恋。

sentences.en: Stephanie had previously worked as an administrative officer for US immigration in Anchorage,
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮此前曾在安克雷奇担任美国移民局的行政官员，

sentences.en: and Smith, who harboured dreams of one day opening an inn in Alaska, was happy to relocate.
sentences.zh: 而怀揣着有一天在阿拉斯加开一家客栈梦想的史密斯，很高兴能搬过去。

sentences.en: The pair married in 2014, and Smith had lived in Anchorage ever since.
sentences.zh: 两人于2014年结婚，此后史密斯一直住在安克雷奇。

sentences.en: He enjoyed exploring the Alaskan wilderness and its remote backcountry, often uploading videos of his adventures online onto his personal YouTube channel.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢探索阿拉斯加的荒野及其偏远的腹地，经常将自己冒险的视频上传到个人的YouTube频道上。

sentences.en: He also shared footage of Stephanie performing on stage as a musician, along with clips from a trip they took to Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 他还分享了斯蒂芬妮作为音乐家在舞台上表演的录像，以及他们夏威夷之旅的剪辑片段。

sentences.en: To those who knew him, Smith came across as someone who was meek, affectionate, and fond of corny dad jokes.
sentences.zh: 在认识他的人看来，史密斯给人的印象是一个温顺、深情且喜欢老掉牙冷笑话的人。

sentences.en: But, despite the public image he projected of a happily married man,
sentences.zh: 但是，尽管他对外塑造了一个婚姻幸福的男人的形象，

sentences.en: Smith was privately frustrated by Stephanie.
sentences.zh: 史密斯私下里对斯蒂芬妮感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Specifically, he felt their sexual connection was lacking.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，他觉得他们的性生活有所欠缺。

sentences.en: Stephanie was two decades older than Smith, and she needed time and forewarning to engage in intimacy.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮比史密斯大二十岁，她需要时间和预告才能进行亲密行为。

sentences.en: Wanting a more spontaneous sex life, Smith began to look outside of his marriage.
sentences.zh: 由于想要更加随性的性生活，史密斯开始将目光投向婚姻之外。

sentences.en: In 2018, Brian Smith turned his attention to Alicia Youngblood, and the two co-workers struck up a romantic relationship.
sentences.zh: 2018年，布赖恩·史密斯将注意力转向了阿莉西亚·杨布拉德，这两个同事擦出了浪漫的火花。

sentences.en: As they grew closer, they began to confide increasingly personal things to one another.
sentences.zh: 随着关系越来越近，他们开始向对方吐露越来越多私密的事情。

sentences.en: They spoke about difficult past experiences, sometimes jokingly trying to one-up each other.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论过去艰难的经历，有时甚至开玩笑般地试图在痛苦上压倒对方。

sentences.en: Smith also shared explicit sexual fantasies with Alicia, sending her messages about how he wanted to tie her up, choke her, and pour vodka down her throat.
sentences.zh: 史密斯还与阿莉西亚分享露骨的性幻想，给她发信息说他想把她绑起来、掐住她，并把伏特加灌进她喉咙里。

sentences.en: But by the middle of August 2018, the fantasies took a troubling turn when Smith shared something deeply disturbing with Alicia.
sentences.zh: 但到了2018年8月中旬，当史密斯与阿莉西亚分享了一些极其令人不安的事情时，这些幻想发生了令人担忧的转变。

sentences.en: He told her that he had killed someone.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，他杀过人。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续制作优质内容。

sentences.en: According to Smith, about a week prior in the early morning hours of Friday, August 3,
sentences.zh: 据史密斯称，大约一周前，即2018年8月3日星期五的清晨，

sentences.en: 2018, he'd picked up a sex worker near the Department of Motor Vehicles building in Anchorage.
sentences.zh: 他在安克雷奇机动车辆管理局大楼附近搭载了一名性工作者。

sentences.en: After the woman got into his car,
sentences.zh: 在这个女人上车后，

sentences.en: Smith drove them both to her small studio apartment, which was located just a few minutes away.
sentences.zh: 史密斯开车载着两人来到她位于几分钟路程外的小单间公寓。

sentences.en: Smith claimed that while they were there, he cut off the sex worker's underwear and removed it from her body.
sentences.zh: 史密斯声称，当他们在那里时，他割断了这名性工作者的内衣并将其从她身上脱了下来。

sentences.en: He then killed her, before taking photos and videos of her corpse.
sentences.zh: 然后他杀死了她，并对她的尸体进行了拍照和录像。

sentences.en: Alicia was horrified by Smith's admission.
sentences.zh: 阿莉西亚对史密斯的供认感到惊恐万分。

sentences.en: She later placed a call to Crimestoppers and shared what she knew about Smith's claims to Anchorage police.
sentences.zh: 她后来拨打匿名灭罪热线，将她所知道的关于史密斯言论的内容告诉了安克雷奇警方。

sentences.en: But, without the alleged victim's name, an address, or any evidence for the detectives to verify, there was little they could do.
sentences.zh: 但是，由于没有所谓受害者的名字、地址，也没有供侦探核实的证据，他们无能为力。

sentences.en: In the meantime, Alicia tried to coax more information from Smith in the hopes he would give her something concrete for police to investigate.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，阿莉西亚试图从史密斯那里套出更多信息，希望他能给她提供供警方调查的具体证据。

sentences.en: She contacted him via Facebook Messenger feigning a prurient interest in his claims and demanding that he provide evidence of the murder.
sentences.zh: 她通过Facebook Messenger联系他，假装对他所说的话有着好色般的兴趣，并要求他提供谋杀的证据。

sentences.en: After some back and forth, Smith told Alicia,
sentences.zh: 经过一番来回拉扯，史密斯告诉阿莉西亚：

sentences.en: Alicia, I think I would like you to see those video clips.
sentences.zh: 艾丽西亚，我想让你看看那些视频片段。

sentences.en: Alicia encouraged Smith to send them to her, replying,
sentences.zh: 艾丽西亚鼓励史密斯把视频发给她，并回复道：

sentences.en: Do you see now why I want to see them so badly?
sentences.zh: 你现在明白为什么我这么想看了吗？

sentences.en: I need to see them.
sentences.zh: 我必须看到它们。

sentences.en: Smith responded,
sentences.zh: 史密斯回应道：

sentences.en: Although Smith never sent Alicia the videos, he did show them to her in person along with some photos.
sentences.zh: 尽管史密斯从未将视频发送给艾丽西亚，但他确实当面给她展示了视频以及一些照片。

sentences.en: Alicia did her best to describe what she'd seen to the police.
sentences.zh: 艾丽西亚尽其所能向警方描述了她所看到的一切。

sentences.en: While the footage hadn't shown an actual murder,
sentences.zh: 虽然录像中没有出现真正的谋杀画面，

sentences.en: Alicia recalled seeing a light-skinned black woman who appeared to be either unconscious or possibly dead.
sentences.zh: 但艾丽西亚回忆说，她看到了一名肤色较浅的黑人女性，她似乎已经失去知觉或可能已经死亡。

sentences.en: In one picture, a naked Brian Smith stood over the woman who was sprawled out with her eyes closed.
sentences.zh: 在一张照片中，赤裸的布莱恩·史密斯站在那名双眼紧闭、瘫倒在地的女性上方。

sentences.en: Some of the videos showed him violating her sexually.
sentences.zh: 其中一些视频显示他对其实施了性侵犯。

sentences.en: Smith told Alicia that he'd wanted to cut her breasts off, but hadn't.
sentences.zh: 史密斯告诉艾丽西亚，他曾想割掉她的乳房，但没有下手。

sentences.en: Terrified that Smith might attack another woman,
sentences.zh: 由于担心史密斯可能会袭击另一名女性，

sentences.en: Alicia kept in regular contact with Anchorage police over the following weeks, updating them with every new admission he made.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，艾丽西亚与安克雷奇警方保持着定期联系，向他们通报他吐露的每一个新情况。

sentences.en: She even handed over her phone so they could access the messages the two had shared, hoping they might find something to kick-start an investigation.
sentences.zh: 她甚至交出了自己的手机，以便警方查阅两人分享的信息，希望能从中找到能让调查启动的线索。

sentences.en: One day, Smith took Alicia to a power plant in Aklutna, a native village within the municipality of Anchorage.
sentences.zh: 一天，史密斯带着艾丽西亚来到安克雷奇自治市内的一个原住民村庄阿克卢特纳的一座发电厂。

sentences.en: He claimed to have dumped the woman's body in the vicinity, pointing out an old mattress and a black bag he said were linked to the crime.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己把那名女性的尸体抛在了附近，并指着一个旧床垫和一个黑色的袋子，称这些都与这起犯罪有关。

sentences.en: Alicia later took the police to this same location.
sentences.zh: 艾丽西亚后来带着警察来到了这个地方。

sentences.en: With the help of a search dog, they located the black bag and took it into evidence.
sentences.zh: 在搜救犬的协助下，他们找到了那个黑色的袋子并作为物证带走了。

sentences.en: However, this bag was later misplaced.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个袋子后来却被弄丢了。

sentences.en: Detectives gained access to Brian Smith's cell phone records to verify whether he had indeed left town on the night of the supposed murder.
sentences.zh: 侦探们调取了布莱恩·史密斯的手机通话记录，以核实他在那起所谓的谋杀当晚是否真的离开过镇子。

sentences.en: His phone had not pinged any towers in the Aklutna area.
sentences.zh: 他的手机没有连接到阿克卢特纳地区的任何基站。

sentences.en: Given that no proof of any crimes was uncovered, investigators began to suspect that Smith's story to Alicia Youngblood was nothing more than a sexual roleplay fantasy.
sentences.zh: 鉴于没有发现任何犯罪证据，调查人员开始怀疑史密斯对艾丽西亚·杨布拉德讲述的故事只不过是性角色扮演的幻想。

sentences.en: After maintaining regular contact with Alicia for about a month,
sentences.zh: 在与艾丽西亚保持了大约一个月的定期联系后，

sentences.en: Anchorage police marked the case file as closed.
sentences.zh: 安克雷奇警方将该案卷标记为结案。

sentences.en: The lead detective noted,
sentences.zh: 主办侦探指出：

sentences.en: Based on the investigation to date, with no possible victim identified and or the video of the incident not seen by anyone other than Alicia Youngblood,
sentences.zh: 根据目前的调查，由于未能确定可能的受害人，且除了艾丽西亚·杨布拉德之外没有人看过案发视频，

sentences.en: this case is being suspended at this time, unless additional information is obtained at a later date.
sentences.zh: 本案目前决定中止侦查，除非日后获得更多线索。

sentences.en: After this, Alicia swiftly left Anchorage with her children and severed ties with Brian Smith for good.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，艾丽西亚带着孩子迅速离开安克雷奇，并彻底切断了与布莱恩·史密斯的联系。

sentences.en: There weren't many South Africans living in Anchorage at the time, so when a detective who had previously investigated Alicia Youngblood's claims
sentences.zh: 当时住在安克雷奇的南非人并不多，因此，当曾调查过艾丽西亚·杨布拉德报案的侦探

sentences.en: reviewed the cell phone footage of a woman being violently attacked in an Anchorage hotel room, one detail stood out.
sentences.zh: 在审查一段一名女性在安克雷奇某酒店房间内遭到暴力袭击的手机录像时，有一个细节引起了注意。

sentences.en: The offender's voice.
sentences.zh: 凶手的声音。

sentences.en: His distinctive accent was instantly recognisable to the investigator.
sentences.zh: 他那独特的口音让调查人员一眼就能辨认出来。

sentences.en: It belonged to 48-year-old Brian Smith.
sentences.zh: 属于48岁的布莱恩·史密斯。

sentences.en: Even more disturbing was the date of the footage.
sentences.zh: 更令人不安的是这段录像的日期。

sentences.en: It had been recorded in September 2019, ruling out the possibility that it was the same video
sentences.zh: 它录制于2019年9月，这就排除了它是那段

sentences.en: Alicia claimed to have seen more than a year earlier in August 2018.
sentences.zh: 艾丽西亚声称在一年多前的2018年8月看到过的视频的可能。

sentences.en: If Alicia had been correct about having seen a video depicting a murdered woman, did this mean Brian Smith had multiple victims?
sentences.zh: 如果艾丽西亚确信自己看到过描绘被害女性的视频，这是否意味着布莱恩·史密斯有多名受害者？

sentences.en: While Smith had worked a few different jobs following his international move, by the time police started investigating him in late 2019,
sentences.zh: 尽管史密斯在跨国搬迁后换过几份工作，但当警方在2019年底开始调查他时，

sentences.en: he was employed as a maintenance worker at the Marriott Town Place Suites in downtown Anchorage, the same hotel where it was believed the cell phone footage was shot.
sentences.zh: 他受雇于安克雷奇市中心的万豪唐普勒套房酒店担任维修工，也就是人们认为那段手机录像拍摄的同一家酒店。

sentences.en: Less than two weeks before the SD card was handed in to police,
sentences.zh: 就在SD卡移交给警方不到两周前，

sentences.en: Smith had obtained his US citizenship and officially became an American.
sentences.zh: 史密斯刚刚获得了美国国籍，正式成为美国人。

sentences.en: His wife had been his financial sponsor.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子是他的财务担保人。

sentences.en: Following the internal tip-off that the man in the video was Brian Smith, detectives checked the Marriott Town Place Suites records
sentences.zh: 根据视频中的男子是布莱恩·史密斯的内部举报，侦探们查阅了万豪唐普勒套房酒店的记录，

sentences.en: and found that Smith had booked room 323 from September 2 until September 4 using his employee discount.
sentences.zh: 发现史密斯利用员工折扣预订了从9月2日到9月4日的323房间。

sentences.en: The carpet in the room also perfectly matched that shown in the images and video footage.
sentences.zh: 房间里的地毯也与图片和视频录像中显示的完全吻合。

sentences.en: Vehicle registration records revealed that Smith and his wife owned a 1999 black Ford Ranger pickup truck, which was consistent with the vehicle used by the assailant.
sentences.zh: 车辆登记记录显示，史密斯和他的妻子拥有一辆1999年产的黑色福特游侠皮卡，这与袭击者使用的车辆吻合。

sentences.en: When detectives zoomed in on the images, they could see a small portion of the truck's license plate making out the numbers 87.
sentences.zh: 当侦探们放大图片时，他们可以看到卡车车牌的一小部分，隐约可见数字87。

sentences.en: The final three numbers on Smith's license plate were 878.
sentences.zh: 史密斯车牌的最后三位数字是878。

sentences.en: Armed with this evidence, detectives wrote up affidavits for warrants to search Brian Smith's home, truck, and cell phone records.
sentences.zh: 掌握了这些证据后，侦探们起草了搜查令申请书，准备搜查布莱恩·史密斯的住所、卡车和手机记录。

sentences.en: Officers visited Smith's residence and workplace, but he wasn't at either location, nor was his truck.
sentences.zh: 警员走访了史密斯的住所和工作场所，但两个地方都不见他的人，他的卡车也不在。

sentences.en: Detectives set up surveillance at the house while a search warrant was executed at room 323 of the Marriott Town Place Suites.
sentences.zh: 侦探们在房子周围进行了监视，同时对万豪唐普勒套房酒店323房间执行了搜查令。

sentences.en: Nothing of significance was found there, but CCTV footage from the hotel's parking lot had captured Smith with the luggage cart,
sentences.zh: 那里没有发现什么有价值的线索，但酒店停车场的闭路电视监控画面拍到了史密斯推着行李车，

sentences.en: loading something wrapped in a white blanket into his truck.
sentences.zh: 将用白色毯子包裹的东西搬上他的卡车。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, detectives studied the face and physical characteristics of the woman in the murder video to try and identify who she might be.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，侦探们仔细研究了谋杀视频中女性的面部和身体特征，试图确定她的身份。

sentences.en: In addition to noting her general appearance, race, and her likely height and weight, she had a small mole in the crease of her right eyelid.
sentences.zh: 除了记录她的整体外貌、种族以及可能的身高体重外，她的右眼睑褶皱处还有一个小痣。

sentences.en: Case detective Brendan Lee cross-checked these features with missing persons reports and Anchorage Police Department databases.
sentences.zh: 负责本案的侦探布伦丹·李将这些特征与失踪人口报告及安克雷奇警察局的数据库进行了交叉比对。

sentences.en: Images of the woman's face were taken from the video, along with pictures of Smith's truck, and distributed to patrol officers and homeless shelters statewide.
sentences.zh: 视频中女性的面部照片以及史密斯的卡车照片被截取并分发给全州的巡逻警员和流浪汉收容所。

sentences.en: Anyone who recognised the woman or had recent contact with her was instructed to pass their information on.
sentences.zh: 任何认出该女性或近期与她有过接触的人都被指示提供线索。

sentences.en: Among the reports of missing women shared with police was that of 30-year-old Kathleen Henry.
sentences.zh: 在警方收到的失踪女性报告中，包括30岁的凯瑟琳·亨利。

sentences.en: She had been living in Anchorage since at least 2016, though she hadn't been in touch with her family for several years.
sentences.zh: 她自2016年以来一直住在安克雷奇，不过她已经有好几年没有与家人联系了。

sentences.en: Kathleen's life had been shaped by hardship.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳的人生充满了坎坷。

sentences.en: She had dropped out of high school, gone through a divorce, struggled with alcohol use, experienced mental health challenges, and had frequent interactions with law enforcement.
